jit.switch: rquickjs_jit::deny_native_code in vendor/quickjs-jit-runtime, called first thing by deep-panel-host and deep-app

decision.text: Measured by issue #358: gpui-shell's 443-node benchmark costs 3.04 ms at worst P99 per update, with a median near 1.65 ms, from an invalidation to a tree the app holds, across the process boundary with the JIT off, on a reference Mac on mains at nominal thermal state, against the 4 ms budget, so the panel host stays.
